title: NSFAS Bursary
eligibility: South African citizens with household income under R350,000 per year
description: Government-funded bursary covering tuition, accommodation, books, and living expenses for qualifying students.

title: Funza Lushaka Bursary
description: Bursary for students pursuing teaching qualifications in priority subjects.

title: Allan Gray Orbis Foundation Fellowship
eligibility: South African students with strong academic record and entrepreneurial potential
description: Fellowship programme supporting future entrepreneurs with funding and mentorship.

title: Sasol Bursary Programme
eligibility: Engineering, Science, IT students with 65%+ average
description: Corporate bursary for STEM students with vacation work opportunities.

title: Eskom Bursary Scheme
eligibility: Engineering and technical students at recognized universities
description: Bursary covering full study costs with guaranteed employment upon graduation.

title: Eastern Cape Provincial Bursary
eligibility: Eastern Cape residents studying at EC institutions
description: Provincial bursary supporting local students in various fields of study.
